CollabBoard.title: CollabBoard
CollabBoard.description: A shared collaborative LinkDraw graph workspace with bounded member list and board settings.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the board owner (immutable).

ownerName.description: Display name of the board owner.

title.description: Title of the collaborative graph board (1-120 chars).

description.description: Short summary of the collaborative graph board (0-300 chars).

inviteCode.description: Uppercase alphanumeric invite code (6-12 chars) referencing /board_invites/{inviteCode}.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (max 20) of authorized collaborator UIDs including ownerId.

memberNames.description: Map of collaborator UID to display name (max 20 entries).

gridSnap.description: Whether canvas grid snapping is enabled.

flowAnimation.description: Whether marching flow particle animation is enabled on edges.

extensions.description: Optional forward-compatible map of platform-specific board settings.

sourcePlatform.description: Optional origin platform identifier (android or web).

BoardInvite.title: BoardInvite
BoardInvite.description: Direct invite code lookup record pointing to a collaborative board.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the board owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when invite was generated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BoardElement.title: BoardElement
BoardElement.description: An individual node, edge, sticky note, or freehand stroke synced natively inside a collaborative board.

kind.description: Element category (core: node, edge, sticky, stroke; extensible for future web/mobile element kinds).

payload.description: Native Firestore Map of element attributes (coordinates, styling, tags, metadata, plus forward-compatible custom attributes).

updatedByUid.description: UID of the collaborator who last created or updated this element.

updatedByName.description: Display name of the collaborator who last touched this element.

sourcePlatform.description: Optional origin platform identifier (android or web).

BoardPresence.title: BoardPresence
BoardPresence.description: Real-time collaborator presence and selected-node indicator keyed by member UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

colorHex.description: Accent color hex for collaborator avatar and cursor/selection ring.

selectedNodeId.description: Optional ID of the node currently focused by this collaborator.

activeTab.description: Current studio tab (core: canvas, notes, utilities, projects; extensible).

cursorX.description: Optional world X coordinate of remote cursor.

cursorY.description: Optional world Y coordinate of remote cursor.

sourcePlatform.description: Optional origin platform identifier (android or web).

BoardComment.title: BoardComment
BoardComment.description: Collaborative team comment or node annotation in a shared board.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the comment author.

authorName.description: Display name of the comment author.

linkedNodeId.description: Optional canvas node ID linked to this comment.

linkedNodeLabel.description: Optional label of the linked canvas node.

CollabNote.title: CollabNote
CollabNote.description: Cloud-synced Document Studio intelligence note (personal or shared board).

noteType.description: Observation, Source, Lead, Analysis, Question, Action, or custom.

/collab_boards/{boardId}.description: Collaborative graph boards accessible only to listed memberUids.

/board_invites/{inviteCode}.description: Invite code lookup records supporting single-document get by code.

/collab_boards/{boardId}/elements/{eleme.description: Per-element graph nodes, edges, sticky notes, and strokes for live multi-user sync.

/collab_boards/{boardId}/presence/{membe.description: Live collaborator presence & node selection indicators.

/collab_boards/{boardId}/comments/{comme.description: Live team comments and node-linked annotations.

/collab_boards/{boardId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Live collaborative Document Studio notes linked to a shared board.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Private cloud-synced Document Studio notes for the signed-in user.
